description: Resume a paused multi-use card so it accepts charges again. The inverse of pause_card.

approval_id.description: Approval id from a prior approval_required response, once the user has approved. Only for cards created through ANOTHER app: first call without it (the user is emailed an approve link), then retry with it.

card_id.description: The paused card ID to resume.

name: resume_card

status.description: "active" on success; an error discriminator otherwise (e.g. "card_not_paused").
